versions.changelog:
Initial release of the "AI大模型专家｜品牌电商带货短剧" skill on AI-HIVE.

- Enables short drama and comic creators, brands, and ecommerce teams to convert scripts, images, and reference videos into deliverable short drama and comic videos.
- Supports various content pipelines: storyboards, character boards, scene boards, and script-based video generation (text-to-video, image-to-video, reference-to-video).
- Includes workflow tools for project planning, character/scene assets, multi-platform adaptation, and real-time task monitoring.
- Provides template scripts and integration examples for blueprint creation, video task management, and result retrieval.
- Designed for commercial delivery with cost/price snapshots, naming conventions, and platform-specific content versions.
